user-registration-diagram.title: User Registration Diagram
user-registration-diagram.definition:
sequenceDiagram
  actor Client
  participant API as Express API
  participant MW as Router / middlewares
  participant Ctrl as Controllers
  participant Val as Validators
  participant Svc as Services
  participant Argon as Argon2id
  participant Repo as Repository
  participant DB as Database
  participant Err as Error handler
  Client->>API: request
  API->>MW: request
  MW->>Ctrl: request
  Ctrl->>Val: req.body
  Val-->>Ctrl: registered / logged in user
  Ctrl->>Svc: user
  Svc->>Argon: password
  Argon-->>Svc: password hash
  Note right of Svc: logs email, username, metadata
  Svc->>Repo: email, username, password hash
  Repo->>DB: write
  alt success
      DB-->>Repo: ok
      Repo-->>Svc: ok
      Svc-->>Ctrl: ok
      Ctrl-->>MW: res
      MW-->>API: res
      API-->>Client: res
  else db / validation / app / node error
      DB-->>Repo: error
      Repo-->>Svc: error
      Svc-->>Ctrl: error
      Ctrl->>Err: error
      Note right of Err: logs error
      Err-->>API: error response
      API-->>Client: error response
  end

default-diagram.title: Default Placeholder Diagram
default-diagram.definition:
sequenceDiagram
  actor Client
  participant API
  participant DB
  Client->>API: request
  API->>DB: query
  DB-->>API: result
  API-->>Client: response
